sections.heading: open.blog documentation
sections.subheading: Write Markdown, get a fast static site with feeds, search, themes and an optional browser editor. Built in Rust and WebAssembly.

sections.markdown: New here? Start with [Getting started](/docs/getting-started/), then [Writing content](/docs/content/) and [Configuration](/docs/configuration/). Every command is in the [command reference](/docs/cli-reference/), and the [decision records](/docs/adr/) explain why the engine works the way it does.
